subject: general
question: In 2023, the Government of India launched the nationwide 'Sarva Dawa Sevan' or mass drug administration to eliminate the disease ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**lymphatic filariasis.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lymphatic filariasis** is a** parasitic infection** that can cause severe **swelling and disability,** known as **elephantiasis.**
 
• It is spread by mosquitoes and affects over **120 million people** worldwide, with the majority of cases in India.
 
• The **Sarva Dawa Sevan program** aims to eliminate lymphatic filariasis by** administering drugs **to entire populations in high-risk areas, regardless of whether they are infected or not.
 
• This approach is known as **mass drug administration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thalassemia** is a **genetic blood disorder**.

 
 
• It affects the production of **hemoglobin**, which can lead to **anemia. **
 
 
 
• **Zika virus** is a mosquito-borne virus.
 
 
• It can cause **birth defects** and **neurological problems**.
 
 
 
• **Multi-drug resistant tuberculosis** (MDR-TB) is a form of tuberculosis that is resistant to the two most powerful anti-TB drugs.
 
 
• It is a** serious public health threat** in India.
